en: A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a walkway between long arcaded stone walls, likely former fortifications, with several people standing and walking along the path. At the far end is a large arched gateway built into an earthen rampart, with trees visible above. The lower margin bears printed captions in red Gothic-style script that identify the scene as a location in Graz and specify 'Schloßberg-Casematten.'
